title: Porsche Newsroom Canada: Porsche customers gain access to the Tesla Supercharger network (2025-09)
notes: Canada: MY2026 Taycan and Macan Electric include the adapter; MY2025 Taycan and all existing Macan Electric customers eligible for a complimentary adapter (notification via My Porsche); MY2024 and older Taycan can purchase, MSRP C$250, Porsche Online Shop or Porsche Centres.
